description: A flaw was found in PackageKit.

_module_comgen_words_and_files() fed untrusted text (module names read off disk, LOADEDMODULES, MODULEPATH) straight into `compgen -W`, which performs a full unquoted-word expansion on its wordlist -- including command substitution -- as a normal, documented part of its behavior.
